## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength); leadership concentrated in Industrials/Materials/Communication (3/5 top performers). Confirmation: broad sector participation but MAJOR divergence among large-cap Tech (MSFT RECOVERY, INTC CORRECTION, AMD CORRECTION, GOOGL BELOW TREND) — suppresses a strong directional call; Style: Value/Cyclical bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication lead: CHTR (1W: +16.66% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND, CMCSA (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +15.22%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: MMM (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, DD (1W: +9.12% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -21.20%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -22.05%) BELOW TREND. Financials showing mixed/soft internals despite positive 1W: SCHW (1W: -4.32% | 1M: -0.92%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +16.66% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND; MMM (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND; DD (1W: +9.12% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 in Materials/Industrials/Communication) — cyclicals driving the advance.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +3.47%) CORRECTION; SCHW (1W: -4.32% | 1M: -0.92%) BELOW TREND; QCOM (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -21.20%) BELOW TREND; TMO (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -12.78%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and services names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: CHTR (1W: +16.66% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND; watch downside momentum in AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -11.79% | 1M: +5.12%) CORRECTION — tactical dispersion among leaders and laggards.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak with distribution in large caps: NVDA (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND but GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND and QCOM (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -21.20%) BELOW TREND — watch for further dispersion and trend confirmation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Internals mixed: JPM (1W: +1.09% | 1M: -3.31%) RECOVERY while SCHW (1W: -4.32% | 1M: -0.92%) BELOW TREND; overall sector 1W positive but look for earnings/capital flow confirmation before adding exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive lean but mixed: PFE (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +8.95%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -20.57%) BELOW TREND — sector holding up on pharma/biotech beats while select insurers lag.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposure within a NEUTRAL framework: emphasize XOM (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +21.65%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.62% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to structurally weak Tech/consumer names like GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND and AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND while monitoring Big Tech trend signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials and Industrials (both showing strong 1W leadership and multiple ABOVE TREND names). BEARISH: Technology and Consumer Discretionary (1W negative, key mega-caps showing CORRECTION/BETWEEN-TRENDS).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA resistance area to watch as ABOVE TREND continuation: NVDA (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL support pivot: AAPL (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN downside momentum break: AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (+80): PFE (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND — FDA priority-review headline confirming price strength. BMY (+50): BMY (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +8.95%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/pipeline optimism matching the rally.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-45): UNH (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -20.57%) BELOW TREND — revenue/outlook worries and price weakness are aligned. Note broader negative headlines in Financials/Industrials (e.g., BLK, HON) are watch points for idiosyncratic risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical bias given broad sector strength but mixed Tech internals. Cyclical leaders showing strength: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.62% | 1M: +20.48%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.17%). Key risk: major divergence within Big Tech (MSFT RECOVERY, INTC CORRECTION, AMD CORRECTION, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and select negative sentiment (UNH) could trigger rotational volatility — monitor for confirmation before adjusting core exposure.
